title: intake's drift rotation skips items forever when the tip moves by more than one commit between runs
goal: Every eligible item's drift checks run within a bounded number of intake runs whatever number of commits lands between them (a sprint landing claim, work and done moves the tip by 3), e.g. by starting after the last item reached instead of at the raw commit count; ST-xq3ghjhb's test advanced exactly one commit per run and could not see it. From the SP-5cwekumc review.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_intake; ids=['TK-a','TK-b','TK-c','TK-d','TK-e','TK-f']; seen=set(); [seen.update(bl_intake.rotated(ids, 100+3*r)[:2]) for r in range(1,51)]; missing=sorted(set(ids)-seen); assert not missing, missing
